timeline.hero_3: History has been edited. You are the correction.
timeline.hero_4:
A book of 80 logic cases set inside the Time Correction Agency. Each one
 is a small paradox in the historical record, and a chain of reasoning
 that puts it right.
timeline.the_briefing_3:
You're a new field investigator. Each case opens with a short scene, 
 a date that doesn't add up, a witness who can't have been there, an
 object that shouldn't exist yet. Your job is to find the single edit
 to the record and reason your way to the only timeline that holds together.
timeline.interactive_sample_3: This is the book’s actual mechanic, a logic grid. There are no dates to recall; everything you need is in the evidence. Mark the grid and verify.

privacy.header_10: SouthStudio respects your privacy. This page explains what we collect when you subscribe to our dispatch or pre-order Timeline, why we collect it, and the rights you have over your data.
privacy.header_12: SouthStudio is an independent studio. For any privacy question, email info@southstudio.online.
privacy.header_14: Newsletter: your email address. Pre-orders: your name, email address and the edition you chose. We never ask for more than we need, and we don't collect payment details on this site.
privacy.header_15: Why we collect it & legal basis
privacy.header_16: We use your details only to send the dispatch you asked for, or to reserve and later fulfil your pre-order. The legal basis is your consent, which you give by submitting the form.
privacy.header_18: We keep your data only as long as needed for that purpose, until you unsubscribe, or until your pre-order is fulfilled or cancelled.
privacy.header_20: Only the service that delivers our email and forms on our behalf. We never sell your data or share it for advertising.
privacy.header_22: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent, at any time, every email has a one-click unsubscribe, and you can reach us at info@southstudio.online. You may also contact your data protection authority.
privacy.header_24: This site stores a little information in your browser to remember your game progress and language preference. We keep tracking to a minimum.
privacy.header_26: If this policy changes, we'll update this page and its date. Last updated: June 2026.
